name: Fortress
hint: Hardened plus every gaming-safe ASR rule on Block, exploit protection, script-host and LOLBin blocks and a minimal network surface.
description: The strongest configuration that competitive anti-cheat still accepts. On top of Hardened: the Safe Mode ASR rule on Block, exploit protection defaults repaired, Windows Script Host off, outbound blocks for tools malware abuses, NTLMv2 only, no anonymous enumeration, no inbound print spooler, Teredo off, NetBIOS, LLMNR and remote access off. VBS, HVCI, TPM and Secure Boot stay exactly as anti-cheat requires. Untrusted programs on USB drives are blocked by the ASR baseline.
guidance: Teredo off: the Xbox app's party chat and some Xbox PC multiplayer titles need Teredo. Remove net.teredo-off from your selection if you use them.
Windows Script Host off: some installers and admin scripts that use .vbs or .js files stop working; re-enable it temporarily if one fails.
Removable-storage auditing comes with the 3.0 device control policies; untrusted executables on USB are already blocked.
